articles.title: Baby Planet Found! It's Less Than 1 Million Years Old
articles.summary: Astronomers found the youngest planet ever seen. It's called Elias 2-24 b, and it's still growing inside a cloud of dust 450 light-years away. It's as big as Jupiter!

articles.title: This $100 Box Can See Invisible Particles From Space!
articles.summary: A device the size of an animal cracker box can detect muons—tiny particles from space that pass through you all the time. It costs only $100 and is used by students and scientists.

articles.title: Kimchi Bacteria May Help Your Body Get Rid of Tiny Plastic Bits
articles.summary: Scientists found that a bacterium from kimchi can stick to nanoplastics in your gut and help flush them out. In mice, it doubled the amount of plastic leaving the body.
